name: dynamic-config-node-remote
description: The eight Rust remote stores for dynamic-config's Node bindings
author: Cevat Batuhan Tolon <cevatbatuhan.tolon@gmail.com>

scripts.build: cargo build -p dynamic-config-node-remote --release && node -e "const {copyFileSync, existsSync} = require('fs'); const built = ['../target/release/libdynamic_config_node_remote.so', '../target/release/libdynamic_config_node_remote.dylib', '../target/release/dynamic_config_node_remote.dll'].find(existsSync); copyFileSync(built, 'index.node')"
